# ReVolta pull request

## Change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior and the affected ReVolta configuration. For an upstream fix, link its source commit or pull request and describe any adaptations. Link related issues and say whether an existing pull request overlaps. State any effect on the [support matrix](https://github.com/Leonccaa/ReVolta/blob/main/docs/known-limits.md#support-matrix).

## Validation

List the exact commands and results. Give the hardware and configuration for runtime checks, and name the configurations you did not verify.

## Attribution

Keep upstream authorship and license notices. Describe any AI assistance, and confirm that the submitting human reviewed every changed line and can explain the change. Sign off every commit under the Developer Certificate of Origin with `git commit -s`.
